resources.string: Scan with your phone camera on the same Wi-Fi, then tap Pair in the browser. Return to your casting app and select this TV. One phone at a time; access lasts 2 hours or until the TV app restarts.

Shown in casting apps. Changes apply the next time this TV app starts. The name alone does not block casting.
Name saved. Restart the TV app to apply.
